pages.title: ORSA Direction Finder
pages.text: $(bold)Recovered designation:$() Acheronite Compass.$(br2)Tower uplink staff used this instrument to reacquire the crashed ORSA relay satellite without wandering the continent like confused interns.$(br2)Once the tower hands you one, the needle binds itself to the relay wreck in the Overworld.$(br2)$(italic)If it spins in circles, congratulations: either the satellite is unresolved or ORSA has lost another orbiting asset.$()

pages.title: Field Notes
pages.text: $(bold)Use:$() Keep it in hand like a normal compass. The lodestone tracking core points at the crashed relay satellite that carries the transponder lead.$(br2)$(bold)Recovery protocol:$() Tower quartermasters finally admitted people lose things under blizzards, in ravines, and inside exploding backpacks.$(br2)If you misplace the original unit, the recovery recipe unlocks after first issue.

pages.title: Recovery Assembly
pages.text: $(bold)Recipe:$() A vanilla compass, two $(item)Acheronite Shards$(), one $(item)Thermal Core$(), and an $(item)Ice Shard$().$(br2)ORSA insists this is a recovery build. Finance insists it is a training fee.
